exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Verb te kuru".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない
動詞てくる

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! 動詞てくる matches "Verb te kuru".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is 動詞てくる.
exercises.explanation: Expresses actions or changes that started in the past and reach the present.
